title: ROSWORLD: When Digital Task Competence Meets Physical Execution
abstract: arXiv:2611.27467v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Computer-use agents now solve most desktop tasks through direct software input, but a robot using the same computer must turn GUI knowledge into physical contact with a keyboard and mouse. We introduce ROSWorld, a benchmark that couples a physically simulated robot workstation to a live OSWorld desktop, so that a robot and a desktop agent pursue the same goals under the same official evaluators. The evaluated model receives observations only from the workstation camera views and operates the peripherals through either a single-arm rigid probe or dual-arm dexterous hands. Across five frontier models and 40 tasks in ten applications, models that complete 31-39 tasks on the desktop complete at most 23 with the probe and 28 with the hands. translated_title: ROSWORLD：当数字任务能力遇上物理执行
translated_abstract: 计算机使用智能体现在可以通过直接软件输入解决大多数桌面任务，但使用同一台计算机的机器人必须将GUI知识转化为与键盘和鼠标的物理接触。我们提出了ROSWorld，这是一个将物理仿真的机器人工作站与实时OSWorld桌面相耦合的基准测试，使机器人和桌面智能体在相同的官方评估器下追求相同的目标。被评估的模型仅从工作站摄像头视角获取观测，并通过单臂刚性探针或双臂灵巧手操作外设。在五个前沿模型和十个应用中的40个任务上，在桌面上可完成31-39个任务的模型，使用探针最多完成23个，使用灵巧手最多完成28个。成对轨迹分析表明，模型会将交互策略调整为倾向于键盘输入，但物理执行经常因按键未命中、目标选择错误和意外的并发输入而失败。
tldr: ROSWorld基准将物理仿真机器人工作站与实时OSWorld桌面相耦合，揭示前沿计算机使用模型虽具备强大的数字任务能力，但在通过物理接触操作键盘和鼠标时性能显著下降。
en_tdlr: ROSWorld couples a physically simulated robot workstation with a live OSWorld desktop, revealing that frontier computer-use agents, despite strong digital task competence, suffer significant performance drops when translating GUI knowledge into physical keyboard and mouse execution.
